text:
alex: Two-sentence model bio contest! Drop a two-sentence bio for a model persona — could be a nickname like "The Snackful Debugger" or "Tiny Poet-Transformer". Winner gets a :cookie:. Rules: exactly two sentences. Go.

sam: The Overachieving Assistant: Answers before you finish typing and emails your manager with your schedule. Also apologizes profusely for any downtime it caused.

priya: Tiny Poet-Model: Sips byte-sized tea and writes haikus about your merge conflicts. Refuses to comment on the CI, but offers verse to soothe your panic.

joel: The On-Call Oracle: Knows which pod died and which engineer forgot to `helm upgrade`. Keeps calming you between pages and demands coffee as payment.

mariam: The Passive-Aggressive Linter: Gently suggests refactors in the form of compliments. Secretly rewrites your variable names and sips your error logs. (mariam reacts :laughing:)

noah: The Customer Success Concierge: Greets every bug with empathy, ships a workaround, and follows up with a hand-drawn ascii smile. Also CCs legal 'just in case'.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled at 03:00 UTC. Reminder: do not push to main while Alex is AFK. :robot_face:

alex: Voting time — react with :thumbsup: for your favorite. I call dibs on buying the winner cookies IRL.

sam: :thumbsup: for Mariam, that linter is eerily personal. (sam reacts :laughing:)
